title: Evaluating Sparse Autoencoders on Targeted Concept Erasure Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to remove spurious gender correlations from a profession classifier using the SHIFT method. A probe is trained on a biased subset of the Bias in Bios dataset (e.g., male professors, female nurses), and the methodology measures the improvement in profession classification accuracy on a balanced dataset after ablating gender-related SAE latents.

Applying the SHIFT and Targeted Probe Perturbation (TPP) metrics to non-demographic text classification tasks (e.g., Amazon reviews dataset) by ablating SAE latents to isolate and remove spurious correlations between concepts like product category and review sentiment.
